crossRefs.note: but the seventh year you shall let it rest and lie fallow, that the poor of your people may eat; and what they leave…
All who believed were together, and had all things in common.
The multitude of those who believed were of one heart and soul. Not one of them claimed that anything of the things…
For neither was there among them any who lacked, for as many as were owners of lands or houses sold them, and brought…
and laid them at the apostles’ feet, and distribution was made to each, according as anyone had need.

translations.web: The Sabbath of the land shall be for food for you; for yourself, for your servant, for your maid, for your hired servant, and for your stranger, who lives as a foreigner with you.
translations.bsb: Whatever the land yields during the Sabbath year shall be food for you—for yourself, your manservant and maidservant, the hired hand or foreigner who stays with you,
translations.kjv: And the sabbath of the land shall be meat for you; for thee, and for thy servant, and for thy maid, and for thy hired servant, and for thy stranger that sojourneth
translations.asv: And the sabbath of the land shall be for food for you; for thee, and for thy servant and for thy maid, and for thy hired servant and for thy stranger, who sojourn with thee.
